strategy: Read and write a project's strategy documents.
strategy carry: Track new items not yet reflected in strategy.
strategy carry candidate-set: List new items to consider in strategy work.
strategy carry mark: Mark carried items as reflected or dismissed.
strategy carry register-new: Record new items since the last strategy pass.
strategy carry summary: Summarize items still waiting to reach strategy.
strategy checkpoint: Record and read strategy review checkpoints.
strategy claim: Claim and release the strategy document an item uses.
strategy claim acquire: Claim the strategy document linked to an item.
strategy claim release: Release a document claim on an item, or a process claim.
strategy coordination: Add entries to a strategy document's sections.
strategy coordination append: Append an entry to a section of a strategy document.
strategy doc: Create, read and edit strategy documents.
strategy doc claim acquire: Lock a strategy document for this session.
strategy doc replace: Replace a strategy document's full text.
strategy doc section-replace: Replace the text under one heading of a document.
strategy doc-claim acquire: Lock a strategy document for this session.
strategy execution: Link items to the strategy documents they carry out.
strategy execution get: Read any item’s linked document and Blitz execution details.
strategy execution link: Link an item to a strategy document.
strategy ingest: Save edited local strategy files back to the server.
strategy parent: Set or clear a strategy document's parent.
strategy parent set: Set or clear a strategy document's parent.
strategy render: Write strategy documents from the server into files.
strategy revision: Compare and restore strategy document revisions.
strategy revision diff: Show changes between two revisions of a document.
strategy revision restore: Restore an earlier revision of a strategy document.
strategy seed-defaults: Create any missing default strategy documents.
strategy surface: Review strategy documents with history and links.
strategy surface get: Show a strategy document with history and links.
strategy surface list: List strategy documents with recent activity.
